```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

Linear mixed-effects modelling of background (clock-like) mutation accumulation
in histologically normal paediatric colonic crypts, separately for single base
substitutions (SBS) and small insertions/deletions (ID), with random intercepts
per donor and location-specific slopes.

## Setup

### Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)     
library(lmerTest)      
library(broom.mixed)
library(patchwork)
```

### Input data

```{r load-data}
crypt_metadata <- read.csv("../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv")
crypt_signature_attributions <- read.csv("../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv")
```

### Shared plotting constants

```{r plot-constants}
location_levels <- c("Ascending", "Transverse", "Sigmoid")

location_cols <- c(
  `Ascending`  = "#84a9c6ff",
  Transverse = "goldenrod3",
 `Sigmoid`  = "palevioletred4"
)

rates_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 15, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement  = "outside",
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing.x  = unit(0.9, "cm"),
    panel.spacing.y  = unit(0, "cm"),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
```

### Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# Tidy the fixed effects of an `age:location` model into a reportable table.
summarise_rate_model <- function(model, mut_type, digits = 0) {
  tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "age:location")) %>%
    mutate(
      location  = str_remove(term, "age:location"),
      mut_type  = mut_type,
      across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), ~ round(.x, digits)),
      text      = paste0(estimate, " mutations/year 95% CI [", conf.low, ", ", conf.high, "]"),
      intercept = round(lme4::fixef(model)[["(Intercept)"]], 0)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      mut_type, location,
      Estimate = estimate,
      lower_ci = conf.low,
      upper_ci = conf.high,
      text, intercept
    )
}

# Expand a rate summary into per-location fitted lines across an age grid.
make_fit_lines <- function(rate_summary, age_grid = seq(0, 20, length.out = 200)) {
  rate_summary %>%
    dplyr::select(location, intercept, slope = Estimate) %>%
    crossing(age = age_grid) %>%
    mutate(
      fit      = intercept + slope * age,
      location = factor(location, levels = location_levels)
    )
}

# One label per location, stacked vertically via a `vjust` column.
make_rate_labels <- function(rate_summary, prefix) {
  rate_summary %>%
    transmute(
      location = factor(location, levels = location_levels),
      label    = paste0(location, " Colon ", prefix, " ~ ", Estimate, " * age")
    ) %>%
    arrange(location) %>%
    mutate(vjust = seq(1, by = 2, length.out = n()))
}

# Fixed-effect table with usable column names (`as.data.frame` keeps the
# original names; `data.frame` would mangle them to `Std..Error` / `Pr...t..`).
coef_table <- function(model) {
  as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients) %>%
    rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
    dplyr::rename(std_error = `Std. Error`, pvalue = `Pr(>|t|)`)
}
```

## 1. Rates of background mutagenesis in children's colonic epithelium

### 1a. Build the analysis dataframe

Burdens are corrected for detection sensitivity, which is derived from coverage
and median VAF. Note that the joined object is given a new name rather than
overwriting `crypt_signature_attributions`, so the chunk is safe to re-run.

```{r build-attributions}
crypt_attributions <- crypt_signature_attributions %>%
  left_join(crypt_metadata, by = c("patient", "biopsy")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Sensitivity-adjust the SBS and ID burdens
    across(starts_with("SBS"), ~ as.numeric(.x) / sensitivitySBS),
    snv_muts   = as.numeric(snv_total_burden) / sensitivitySBS,
    indel_muts = as.numeric(indel_total_burden) / sensitivityID,
    # Background SBS burden (computed after the adjustment above)
    SBSBackground = SBS1 + SBS5 + SBS18
  )
```

Restrict to histologically normal, colibactin-negative, SBS89/ID25-negative
crypts from the three locations with sufficient sampling.

```{r build-background-df}
background_df <- crypt_attributions %>%
  filter(
    cohort != "IBD",
    colonoscopy_finding != "FAP",
    biopsy_SBS89_ID83C_pos == FALSE,
    patient_colibactin_pos == FALSE
  ) %>%
  
  filter(location %in% location_levels) %>%
  # Retain crypts with clonal indel calls only
  filter(indel_median_vaf > 0.3)
```

```{r background-df-donors}
n_distinct(background_df$patient)
```

### 1b. Rates of single base substitutions

#### i. Model selection

Fit age-only and `age:location` models. The interaction term (without a location
main effect) gives a separate slope per location with a shared intercept.

```{r sbs-models}
age_only_lmer         <- lmer(SBSBackground ~ age + (1 | patient), data = background_df)
age_location_lmer     <- lmer(SBSBackground ~ age:location + (1 | patient), data = background_df)
```

```{r sbs-aic}
# AIC improves when location is included
AIC(age_only_lmer, age_location_lmer)
```

Likelihood ratio test — fitting separate slopes per location significantly
improves model fit (p < 0.001).

```{r sbs-anova}
anova(age_only_lmer, age_location_lmer)
```

#### ii. Model summary

```{r sbs-summary}
sbs_summary <- summarise_rate_model(age_location_lmer, mut_type = "SBS", digits = 0)
sbs_summary
```

#### iii. Plot SBS background rates

Biopsy-level summary (median and IQR across crypts within a biopsy).

```{r sbs-biopsy-summary}
sbs_biopsy_sum <- background_df %>%
  group_by(biopsy) %>%
  summarise(
    SBSBackground_median = median(SBSBackground, na.rm = TRUE),
    SBSBackground_lwr    = unname(quantile(SBSBackground, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
    SBSBackground_upr    = unname(quantile(SBSBackground, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    age                  = median(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    location             = dplyr::first(location),
    cohort               = dplyr::first(cohort),
    site                 = dplyr::first(site),
    crypts               = n(),
    biopsy_SBS89_ID83C_pos  = dplyr::first(biopsy_SBS89_ID83C_pos),
    patient_colibactin_pos = as.factor(max(patient_colibactin_pos)),
    patient              = dplyr::first(patient),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    location = factor(location, levels = location_levels),
    rate     = SBSBackground_median / age
  )
```

```{r sbs-plot-data}
sbs_lines  <- make_fit_lines(sbs_summary)
sbs_labels <- make_rate_labels(sbs_summary, prefix = "SBS Background")
```

```{r sbs-plot, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
sbs_plot <- ggplot(sbs_biopsy_sum, aes(x = age, y = SBSBackground_median, colour = location)) +

  # Per-biopsy point and IQR error bar
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = SBSBackground_lwr, ymax = SBSBackground_upr),
    width = 0, colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 6) +

  # Fitted slope per location
  geom_line(
    data = sbs_lines, aes(x = age, y = fit, colour = location),
    linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  # Annotate each location's rate
  geom_text(
    data = sbs_labels, aes(x = 0, y = 1500, label = label, vjust = vjust),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 5, colour = "black"
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = location_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-100, 1500)) +
  labs(x = "Donor Age at Biopsy [years]", y = "Background SBS Mutations") +
  rates_theme

sbs_plot
```

```{r sbs-plot-export, results = "hide"}
ggsave("../Figure1/sbs_rates.svg", sbs_plot, width = 12, height = 8)
```

### 1c. Rates of small insertions and deletions

#### i. Model selection

```{r id-models}
indel_age_only_lmer     <- lmer(indel_muts ~ age + (1 | patient), data = background_df)
indel_age_location_lmer <- lmer(indel_muts ~ age:location + (1 | patient), data = background_df)
```

As for SBS, AIC and the likelihood ratio test both favour location-specific
slopes (p < 0.001).

```{r id-aic}
AIC(indel_age_only_lmer, indel_age_location_lmer)
```

```{r id-anova}
anova(indel_age_only_lmer, indel_age_location_lmer)
```

#### ii. Model summary

```{r id-summary}
id_summary <- summarise_rate_model(indel_age_location_lmer, mut_type = "ID", digits = 1)
id_summary
```

#### iii. Plot ID background rates

```{r id-biopsy-summary}
id_biopsy_sum <- background_df %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Flatten any list-columns carried through from the attribution table
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ unlist(.x))) %>%
  group_by(biopsy) %>%
  summarise(
    IDBackground_median = median(indel_muts, na.rm = TRUE),
    IDBackground_lwr    = unname(quantile(indel_muts, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
    IDBackground_upr    = unname(quantile(indel_muts, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    age                 = median(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    cohort              = dplyr::first(cohort),
    site                = dplyr::first(site),
    location            = dplyr::first(location),
    patient_colibactin_pos = as.factor(max(patient_colibactin_pos)),
    patient             = dplyr::first(patient),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    site     = factor(site, levels = c("Left", "Right")),
    location = factor(location, levels = location_levels)
  )
```

```{r id-plot-data}
id_lines  <- make_fit_lines(id_summary)
id_labels <- make_rate_labels(id_summary, prefix = "ID Background")
```

```{r id-plot, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
id_plot <- ggplot(id_biopsy_sum, aes(x = age, y = IDBackground_median, colour = location)) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = IDBackground_lwr, ymax = IDBackground_upr),
    width = 0, colour = "grey30"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +

  geom_line(
    data = id_lines, aes(x = age, y = fit, colour = location),
    linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = id_labels, aes(x = 0, y = 50, label = label, vjust = vjust),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 5, colour = "black"
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = location_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 50)) +
  labs(x = "Donor Age at Biopsy [years]", y = "Background ID Mutations") +
  rates_theme

id_plot
```

```{r id-plot-export, results = "hide"}
ggsave("../Figure1/id_rates.svg", id_plot, width = 12, height = 8)
```

### 1d. Export rate estimates

```{r export-rates}
background_rates_summary <- bind_rows(sbs_summary, id_summary) %>%
  dplyr::select(-text)

write.csv(
  background_rates_summary,
  "../Data/background_mutation_rates.csv",
  quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)
```

### 1e. Comparison of background burden between cohorts

#### i. SBS burden

All colibactin-negative, SBS89/ID25-negative crypts, retaining the IBD cohort.

```{r cohort-df}
compare_cohort_df <- crypt_attributions %>%
  filter(biopsy_SBS89_ID83C_pos == FALSE, patient_colibactin_pos == FALSE)%>%
  mutate(cohort=factor(cohort,levels=c("Normal" ,"IBD")))
```

```{r cohort-models}
age_location_ibd_included_lmer <- lmer(
  SBSBackground ~ age:site + (1 | patient),
  data = compare_cohort_df
)
age_location_cohort_lmer <- lmer(
  SBSBackground ~ age:site + cohort + (1 | patient),
  data = compare_cohort_df
)
```

Does adding cohort improve prediction of background burden?

```{r cohort-anova}
anova(age_location_cohort_lmer, age_location_ibd_included_lmer)
```

```{r cohort-summary}
cohort_comparison_conf_int <- as.data.frame(confint(age_location_cohort_lmer)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  dplyr::rename(lower_ci = `2.5 %`, upper_ci = `97.5 %`)

cohort_comparison_summary <- coef_table(age_location_cohort_lmer) %>%
  left_join(cohort_comparison_conf_int, by = "variable") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Estimate, lower_ci, upper_ci), ~ round(.x, digits = 0)),
    pvalue = round(pvalue, digits = 3),
    text   = paste0(Estimate, " mutations 95% CI [", lower_ci, ", ", upper_ci, "]")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, Estimate, pvalue, text)
```

A positive estimate indicates a higher in IBD cohort
(reported: 149 mutations 95% CI [59, 239]).

```{r cohort-summary-print}
cohort_comparison_summary
```

#### ii. Per-signature effect of cohort

```{r per-signature}
signature_models <- c("SBS1", "SBS5", "SBS18") %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(~ lmer(
    as.formula(paste0(.x, " ~ age:site + cohort + (1 | patient)")),
    data = compare_cohort_df
  ))

# Signs are flipped to absolute values because the Normal cohort has the lower rate
signature_effects <- signature_models %>%
  map_dfr(
    ~ coef_table(.x) %>%
      filter(variable == "cohortIBD") %>%
      transmute(
        estimate = round(abs(Estimate), 0),
        lower_ci = abs(round(Estimate + 1.96 * std_error, 0)),
        upper_ci = abs(round(Estimate - 1.96 * std_error, 0)),
        pvalue   = round(pvalue, 3)
      ),
    .id = "signature"
  ) %>%
  mutate(text = paste0(estimate, " mutations 95% CI [", lower_ci, ", ", upper_ci, "], p = ", pvalue))

signature_effects
```

#### iii. ID burden

```{r id-cohort-model}
indel_age_location_cohort_lmer <- lmer(
  indel_muts ~ age:site + cohort + (1 | patient),
  data = compare_cohort_df
)
```

```{r id-cohort-summary}
id_ibd_conf <- as.data.frame(confint(indel_age_location_cohort_lmer)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  dplyr::rename(lower_ci = `2.5 %`, upper_ci = `97.5 %`)

id_ibd_summary <- coef_table(indel_age_location_cohort_lmer) %>%
  left_join(id_ibd_conf, by = "variable") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Estimate, lower_ci, upper_ci), ~ (round(.x, digits = 1))),
    pvalue=round(pvalue,4),
    text = paste0(Estimate, " mutations/year 95% CI [", lower_ci, ", ", upper_ci, "]")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, Estimate, pvalue, text)

id_ibd_summary
```

### 1f. Burden of structural variants

```{r load-svs}
structural_variant_df <- read.csv("../Data/structural_variants.csv")

# De-duplicate on the breakpoint coordinates themselves. Pasting the fields into
# a single string without a separator can collide (e.g. 1 + 23 vs 12 + 3).
unique_svs <- structural_variant_df %>%
  distinct(chromosome1, start1, start2, patient, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r sv-counts}
cat(
  sprintf("Unique structural variants:    %d\n", nrow(unique_svs)),
  sprintf("Crypts with a structural variant: %d\n", n_distinct(structural_variant_df$crypt)),
  sprintf("Unique SVs in PD65118:         %d\n", sum(unique_svs$patient == "PD65118")),
  sep = ""
)
```

```{r sv-by-type}
count(unique_svs, type)
```

#### Association with colibactin exposure

```{r sv-enrichment}
# `crypt_attributions` already carries the biopsy metadata, so no further join
# to `crypt_metadata` is needed (that would duplicate every column as .x / .y).
test_sv_enrichment_df <- structural_variant_df %>%
  count(crypt, name = "structural_variants") %>%
  right_join(crypt_attributions, by = "crypt") %>%
  mutate(structural_variants = replace_na(structural_variants, 0))

sv_enrichment_lmer <- lmer(
  structural_variants ~ patient_colibactin_pos + age + (1 | patient),
  data = test_sv_enrichment_df
)

sv_effect <- coef_table(sv_enrichment_lmer) %>%
  filter(variable == "patient_colibactin_posTRUE") %>%
  transmute(
    estimate = round(Estimate, 2),
    lower_ci = round(Estimate - 1.96 * std_error, 2),
    upper_ci = round(Estimate + 1.96 * std_error, 2),
    pvalue   = round(pvalue, 3)
  )

cat(sprintf(
  "Estimate: %s [%s, %s], p = %s\n",
  sv_effect$estimate, sv_effect$lower_ci, sv_effect$upper_ci, sv_effect$pvalue
))
```
